# vendor/

`mnema-talk-sdk-3.0.11.tgz` is the official TypeScript SDK of Mnema Talk
(`sdk/typescript` in [msch128/mnema-talk](https://github.com/msch128/mnema-talk),
AGPL-3.0), packed with `npm pack` from the bot platform branch
(`msch128/feat-bot-platform`) before the SDK's first release.

Once a Mnema Talk release carries the SDK as a release asset, `package.json`
points there instead and this folder goes away (README, "The SDK dependency").
